items.statement: Agents can't find pnpm on PATH and rebuild a corepack workaround in every session
items.evidence:
session 1, 2026-10-19T18:08: the agent checked Node, corepack and pnpm locations, then built a corepack pnpm shim before install and the gates could run.
session 2, 2026-10-30T07:38: install failed because pnpm was not found; the agent searched again, switched to corepack pnpm and built a shim so the Turborepo gates could run.
README.md:27 already says to run `corepack enable pnpm` once; GROUNDING.md, which agents read first, does not.
items.fix:
GROUNDING.md, Quality Control, add one line after the intro sentence:
+ pnpm comes through corepack (`packageManager` in package.json): run `corepack enable pnpm` once so Turborepo finds `pnpm` on PATH (README, Development); until then, use `corepack pnpm`.
On the developer's machine, running `corepack enable pnpm` once removes the cause.

items.statement: The Dependabot `labels` settings do nothing: none of the labels exist, so every Dependabot PR goes out unlabelled with a "labels could not be found" bot comment
items.evidence:
.github/dependabot.yml:15 sets `labels: [dependencies, github-actions]` and :40 sets `labels: [dependencies, npm]`, both since b205428 (2026-10-01).
The repo's 11 labels include none of `dependencies`, `github-actions`, `npm`; every Dependabot PR (#2, #40–#44, #46, #47, #49, #51–#55) has no label.
Dependabot's bot comment names the missing labels on #46, #47, #49, #53, #54, #55 (retro-prs: #49; retro-sessions: session evidence 2026-10-30).
No ADR requires these labels; the only mention is plan history (toucan-v1/progress.md:155).
items.fix:
(git apply --check passes at 21ad398)
--- a/.github/dependabot.yml
+++ b/.github/dependabot.yml
@@ -12,7 +12,6 @@
     cooldown:
       default-days: 7
     open-pull-requests-limit: 3
-    labels: [dependencies, github-actions]
     commit-message:
       prefix: deps
       include: scope
@@ -37,7 +36,6 @@
       default-days: 7
       semver-major-days: 14
     open-pull-requests-limit: 5
-    labels: [dependencies, npm]
     commit-message:
       prefix: deps
       include: scope
Note: without `labels`, Dependabot uses its defaults (`dependencies` plus the ecosystem) and creates them, so PRs get labelled under the default names. See the question under "Needs the developer".

data.text: No record carries a Retire when: line, so there was no retire condition to check. No near-twin group survived a read: the two 'deliver in three PRs' decisions are each their own plan's delivery, not one rule.

Not raised by any lane: 21 plan decisions that an ADR's Decided in / Lifted from names have no `Lifted to ADR-NNNN` back-line, which architecture-maintenance/0001 asks for. toucan-v1/0013's status reads 'Partly superseded', which is not a standard value.
